Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XLVIII OF 2001
ORDINANCE XLVIII OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
GROUND WATER RIGHTS ADMINISTRATION
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
An
Ordinance further to amend the Balochistan
Ground
Water Rights Administration Ordinance, 1978
[Gazette
of Balochistan, Extraordinary,
7th
November, 2001]
No.Legis.l‑54/Law/80,
dated 7‑11‑2001.‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Balochistan on 3rd November, 2001 , is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
1. Short
title and commencement. ‑‑‑(1)
This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Ground Water Right Administration
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall
come into force at once

of section 3 of Act IX of 1978.‑‑‑In the Balochistan Ground Water Rights Administration Ordinance,

deleted.
